# Legacy archive compatibility fixture

`legacy-rust-profile.mzar` was generated by the v1.3.0 Rust archive implementation before removing that runtime. It contains a synthetic Profile named `Legacy Rust archive fixture`, a `compatibility.txt` file containing `legacy browser data\n`, and a fixed fingerprint seed stored as `18446744073709551615`.

The test-only passphrase is `legacy-test-passphrase`. This fixture contains no real accounts, credentials, cookies, or user data. Its purpose is to ensure that the Go implementation can import the existing encrypted archive format.
